name: Slender Flatsedge
desc: Slender Flatsedge (Cyperus bipartitus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cyperus bipartitus, also known as slender flatsedge, river cyperus, or shining flatsedge, is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family Cyperaceae.
